name: Claude sessions
author: mulm
description: Running Claude Code sessions and whether each is working, waiting for you, or done, plus a tokscale-style usage panel.

barWidget.description: Usage gauge (session limit + today's cost) that opens a tokscale-style usage panel, then one indicator per running Claude Code session: spinner + elapsed while working, bell when it needs you, check when done. Click a session to focus its terminal.

schema.label: Usage in bar
schema.description: Next to the gauge: the 5-hour session limit used, today's estimated cost, both, or nothing.

schema.label: Usage refresh (seconds)
schema.description: How often tokscale re-reads the local Claude Code transcripts.

schema.label: Limits refresh (seconds)
schema.description: How often the widget re-reads the limits. They come from the Claude Code statusline while a session runs; Anthropic is asked through tokscale at most every 5 minutes.
